QuestInfo.name: [Lachelein] A Party That Never Ends
QuestInfo.0: You still have more to ask Gray Mask. You should talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Maybe Gray Mask is wrong. You should try an pass through the fog to find out for sure.
QuestInfo.2: You couldn't pass through the fog. At least the Awakened Ones' hideout seems safe enough for now.

0.conditionContent: Attempt to pass through the red fog

0.msg: You must have many questions. I will tell you about this place.

1.msg: Lachelein is a city of madness. The people here eat, drink, and dance in a festival that never ends. They're trapped in Lucid's dream, with no idea that any of it is strange in the least.

5.msg: We were once like the others, blinded by the dream, in all its allure. But one by one, we awakened to the truth. Now, our existence puts Lucid's vision in jeopardy, so she sends her minions to hunt us. #rWe stay in hiding... for fear we may be transformed into butterflies, doomed to disappear again and again.

7.msg: Impossible. The #rfog surrounding the city#k will not let anyone escape. Try it for yourself if you don't believe me.

8.msg: Try and leave, you'll see. I'll send you to the city's edge.

yes.0: I'd like to think you'll succeed where we have failed, but... I doubt it.

no.0: I guess you need time to prepare yourself.

0.msg: #bI can't get out... But I have to reach the end of the river...!

1.msg: Looks like you're in the same boat as us.

yes.0: Protective Mask has something to say to you.
